title: 一间房、三个夜晚与尚未结束的账
scope: Synthetic hotel PMS: one room, three local nights [2026-10-24,2026-10-27), Europe/Berlin; EUR minor units; distinct room-night capacity, physical assignment, readiness, stay, folio, authorization, payment and refund. No tax, FX, fees, statutory invoice or deposit-law conclusions. Mews is a documented product reference, not the asserted implementer of this design. Stripe explains its own authorization/capture contract; no Mews-Stripe integration is claimed.

transitions.guard: 权限、报价版本、逐夜容量与同房候选通过
transitions.durable_effect: 同事务保存 hold 有效期、逐夜占用与全程暂定实体房分配；不换房承诺不能只依赖汇总容量
transitions.recovery: 响应丢失按 operation 找回原 hold

transitions.guard: hold 未过期；付款/担保满足本例策略
transitions.durable_effect: 保存确认及容量承诺
transitions.recovery: 支付迟到先查 hold 与容量

transitions.guard: 当前 hold 仍有效且已到期
transitions.durable_effect: 释放全部日期及暂定实体房区间，保留到期事实
transitions.recovery: 同一任务重放不二次加库存

transitions.guard: 取消规则版本、权限与客人确认
transitions.durable_effect: 释放容量并建立可能的退款义务
transitions.recovery: 退款失败不把取消伪装成未发生

transitions.guard: 原版本有效；新日期容量及配房约束均满足
transitions.durable_effect: 原子替换受影响夜晚；保存新版本
transitions.recovery: 新日期失败则原承诺完整保留

transitions.guard: hold 有效且关联预订确认
transitions.durable_effect: 逐夜占用类型改变，不重复扣减
transitions.recovery: 唯一 (hotel,reservation,date) 业务键拒绝重复效果；容量桶身份另为 (hotel,category,date)

transitions.guard: 尚未 committed
transitions.durable_effect: 全部 hold 夜晚原子释放
transitions.recovery: 检查已释放版本后跳过

transitions.guard: 获准变更及版本检查
transitions.durable_effect: 受影响承诺解除，历史保留
transitions.recovery: 事务失败保留原占用

transitions.guard: 实体房无重叠、符合房型设施及完整区间
transitions.durable_effect: 保存 room ID、区间、锁定及版本
transitions.recovery: 冲突重选；不借平均余量绕过

transitions.guard: 权限、客人同意及新片段可行
transitions.durable_effect: 版本化替换片段，保留转移记录
transitions.recovery: 准备失败保留原承诺或人工安置

transitions.guard: 住宿离店确认
transitions.durable_effect: 释放实际使用并触发准备任务
transitions.recovery: 任务重放不重复建立占用

transitions.trigger: hold 到期或预订获准取消
transitions.guard: 确认对应占用未被有效续期或转为其他承诺
transitions.durable_effect: 与夜容量原子释放暂定房区间
transitions.recovery: 检查 hold/预订版本；迟到释放不能解除已确认占用

transitions.guard: 角色有权且对象版本有效
transitions.durable_effect: 保存清洁完成证据
transitions.recovery: 未检验不得直接入住

transitions.guard: 检查员权限与检查结果通过
transitions.durable_effect: 保存检查证据与新版本
transitions.recovery: 重复动作返回现有结果

transitions.guard: 关联住宿已离店
transitions.durable_effect: 新一轮准备版本
transitions.recovery: 迟到旧 inspected 通知不覆盖 dirty

transitions.guard: 故障事实与权限
transitions.durable_effect: 阻止新入住并更新可售容量
transitions.recovery: 已接承诺进入重配/安置队列

transitions.guard: 维修验收证据
transitions.durable_effect: 恢复可准备状态，仍需清洁检查
transitions.recovery: 未通过不恢复出售

transitions.guard: confirmed；分配无冲突；inspected；时间及身份满足
transitions.durable_effect: 保存实际入住 UTC 与关联房间版本
transitions.recovery: 超时查原 operation；不新建第二次住宿

transitions.guard: 已知费用结清或明确获批承担/欠款例外；待办可见
transitions.durable_effect: 记录离店、冻结账夹快照、触发清洁及对账
transitions.recovery: 迟到消费保留旧客补账义务，不恢复在住

transitions.guard: 费用路由、待投递与付款状态已经列明
transitions.durable_effect: 保存核对快照并停止新即时挂账
transitions.recovery: 外部未知保持待核对，可撤回冻结

transitions.guard: 授权重开且尚未 closed
transitions.durable_effect: 保留前次快照并增加新版本
transitions.recovery: 已关闭改用关联调整，不无痕改写

transitions.guard: 费用已结清或应收承担安排有效；未知项有独立待办
transitions.durable_effect: 冻结已出账记录并保留收款/退款任务
transitions.recovery: 晚到消费进入补账审查，不改 closed 历史

transitions.guard: 匹配同一 operation 与金额
transitions.durable_effect: 保存有效授权额及期限，不增加实收
transitions.recovery: 未知继续查询，不猜测成功

transitions.guard: 同一外部对象核对
transitions.durable_effect: 保存原因
transitions.recovery: 客人选择其他方式创建新尝试

transitions.guard: 金额不超过可用额度且授权有效
transitions.durable_effect: 保存 capture operation
transitions.recovery: 超时核对；不再次 capture

transitions.guard: 核对已收金额
transitions.durable_effect: 产生关联实际收款一次
transitions.recovery: 旧 pending 回执不得回退

transitions.guard: 尚未 capture 且期限已过
transitions.durable_effect: 清除可用授权，不改实收
transitions.recovery: 重新授权必须新 operation

transitions.guard: 尚未 capture；外部取消确认
transitions.durable_effect: 保存释放确认，不产生退款
transitions.recovery: 已 capture 则走退款对象

transitions.guard: 同一请款尝试已核对为失败
transitions.durable_effect: 记录原因，不增加实收；应收仍存在
transitions.recovery: 由前台取得新支付方式或新授权，不复用已失效授权

transitions.guard: 身份金额与责任账户匹配
transitions.durable_effect: 增加实收一次；保存 provider ID
transitions.recovery: 崩溃重放读取已有支付

transitions.guard: 当前权威状态核对
transitions.durable_effect: 保存失败，无资金效果
transitions.recovery: 新尝试不覆盖失败历史

transitions.guard: 批准原因、原收款及可退金额检查
transitions.durable_effect: 保存独立 refund ID
transitions.recovery: 响应未知先核对，不新开退款

transitions.guard: 核对同一 refund 当前状态
transitions.durable_effect: 减少净实收一次，关闭该退款义务
transitions.recovery: 回放不可重复减少

transitions.guard: 当前状态核对
transitions.durable_effect: 义务仍存在，保存失败原因
transitions.recovery: 财务选择可行新尝试，不显示已到账

transitions.guard: 请求已持久化且无已完成效果
transitions.durable_effect: 记录发送尝试
transitions.recovery: 发送前崩溃可恢复原请求

transitions.guard: 无法确认是否受理
transitions.durable_effect: 保存未知与下一核对时间
transitions.recovery: 按外部身份核对，不盲目重复

transitions.guard: 核对业务结果
transitions.durable_effect: 保存结果并更新投影
transitions.recovery: 崩溃后重放读取已完成效果

transitions.guard: 确认该尝试未成功
transitions.durable_effect: 保存原因供重选
transitions.recovery: 不得把 rejected 自动改成功

transitions.guard: 同一业务尝试的权威证据
transitions.durable_effect: 补齐本地结果一次
transitions.recovery: 迟到回执只补证据

transitions.guard: 有明确失败或不存在且安全重试依据
transitions.durable_effect: 结束原尝试
transitions.recovery: 无法确定则继续 unknown，交人工

checks.given: R1 three nights; prices 12000/15000/13000; POS 6000; collected deposit 10000; valid auth 8000; room inspected
checks.when: check in; post POS; confirm capture 8000 and separate payment 28000; check out
checks.then: departed; charge=46000; confirmed receipts=46000; folio reconciled; readiness task exists
checks.evidence_required: UI states; authoritative stay, charge and payment records; operation history; arithmetic fixture

checks.given: one ticket line for 6000 with stable hotel/outlet/ticket/line key
checks.when: deliver twice, including distinct delivery IDs
checks.then: one business charge of 6000, with delivery history retained
checks.evidence_required: inbox identities; unique business key; folio sum

checks.given: capture already confirmed by external system
checks.when: old pending message arrives after confirmed message
checks.then: reconcile current external object; no unjustified regression or second receipt
checks.evidence_required: arrival log, external read and final payment version

checks.given: capacity 1 for each requested night; two valid requests view remaining=1
checks.then: one accepted; other conflict; no negative count or partially consumed dates
checks.evidence_required: transaction outcomes; all affected nightly rows; rejected UI action

checks.given: two hotels use room A and ticket 17
checks.when: lookup and posting with cache hit and miss in hotel H1
checks.then: only H1 identities and authorized data; no H2 mutation
checks.evidence_required: query scope, cache keys, denied cross-hotel action and resulting rows

checks.given: external system captured 8000 but response is lost
checks.then: operation unknown until authoritative reconciliation; one capture and one receipt
checks.evidence_required: operation ledger; provider lookup; UI waiting/recovery path

checks.given: charge committed but inbox marker not yet written
checks.then: one charge; processed marker eventually explained
checks.evidence_required: before/after persisted state, restart/replay log and final totals

checks.when: count local dates and sum per-night rate
checks.then: 3 nights; 40000 cents; midnight UTC elapsed 73h and planned elapsed 69h do not replace date count
checks.evidence_required: fixed timezone input, local dates, UTC conversions and hand calculation

checks.given: A occupied [24,25), B occupied [25,26); requested [24,26); no moves
checks.when: check daily spare capacity then full-room feasibility
checks.then: daily spare [1,1] but candidate intersection empty; reject same-room promise
checks.evidence_required: room/day fixture; empty intersection; explicit refusal

checks.given: room cleaned but not inspected; separate guest has no-post flag
checks.when: force direct API check-in or room-charge command
checks.then: both refused by their respective guards; no stay or charge side effect
checks.evidence_required: server authorization/guard log; object versions; UI feedback

checks.given: G/R1 consumed at 10:00, departed 11:00; same room later belongs to H/R2
checks.when: G ticket arrives 11:10 or after room reassignment
checks.then: preserve G/R1; review late charge; H folio unchanged; closed original snapshot unchanged
checks.evidence_required: source ticket account/stay/time, review task and both folios

checks.given: 40 EUR refund requested for guest overpayment
checks.then: departure unchanged; refund obligation remains open; no confirmed refund amount
checks.evidence_required: refund ID/state history; UI text; personal account reconciliation

checks.given: hold expired and last capacity sold elsewhere; original payment later succeeds
checks.then: no negative capacity or automatic reservation confirmation; refund/accommodation task created
checks.evidence_required: hold and capacity versions; late payment record; compensation task

checks.given: company accepts room 40000; guest food 6000; guest deposit 10000; authorization 8000 uncharged
checks.when: route charges and reconcile each payer separately
checks.then: company receivable 40000; guest refund due 4000; release unused auth; no personal collection 28000
checks.evidence_required: routing rule/version; per-account ledger; refund and authorization operations
